referenceComposition: <svg data-slot="spinner" class="ui-spinner-default" role="status" aria-label="Loading contacts" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M20 12a8 8 0 1 1-8-8" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/></svg>
sourceFacts: Exact wrapper props/slots/native output from sources/react-api-inventory.json and pinned code.
contentAlternative: The actual wrapper has role=status and default aria-label=Loading; this reference supplies a task-specific localized name. Animation is supplementary.
updatesAndDescendants: Spinner renders the selected icon with an animation class; it does not start tasks, calculate progress or determine completion. The task owner removes/replaces the status on completion/failure. Reduced motion may stop rotation while keeping the accessible status.
referenceDecision: The task-specific label and reduced-motion policy are explicit usage decisions. The icon-family picker on the registry website is outside the component API.
keyboard: This default content wrapper does not install a keyboard listener or roving focus. Native links/buttons/inputs in the chosen children retain their own documented semantics. Label delegates native focus through its associated control.
naming: The HTML projection identifies all required visible content/labels. No unnecessary ARIA role/name is imposed on native text, headings, kbd or tables.

indicator.description: Actual named role=status SVG, with caller naming for task context.
